latest_final: The apparent portrait was actually the window opposite her bed. In the dim room at night, the view through it looked like a picture, but in the morning she saw a living man outside, looking directly into her room. She realized he had also been looking in during the night, while she believed she was looking at a portrait. That discovery—that she had been watched without knowing it—stunned her. The story does not establish who the man was or why he was there.
